template.name: Bull vs Medved
template.entry_long: close > open and close - open > atr(high,low,close,{p0})
template.exit_long: close < open and open - close > atr(high,low,close,{p1})
template.notes: The latest candle must print a bullish body larger than the CandleSizePips threshold; since that value is undocumented the body is scaled by ATR(14) rather than an invented pip figure. The six trading windows, the three-candle regular/cool bull patterns, the bad-bull filter and the buy-limit indents need clock and shifted-bar data and are dropped, as are the pip stop distances.
